svg.title: Airtanker · diamond marker
svg.desc: Master at the origin; placed on the shared crest band at (452.0, 426.6) and (996.0, 426.6). Isolated from airtanker-operations/airtanker-operations-editable.svg → #diamond. Original coordinates retained; only the viewBox is cropped. Reference-based reconstruction, not an official master.
